sentences.text:
Bench: Mamidanna Satya Ratna Sri Ramachandra Rao, Ajay Mohan Goel
Dharam Singh vs. State of H.P. & Ors.

entities.text: Mamidanna Satya Ratna Sri Ramachandra Rao
entities.label: JUDGE

sentences.text: Present: Mr. Karan Singh Kanwar, Advocate, for the petitioner.

Mr. Anup Rattan, Advocate General, with Mr. Pranay Pratap Singh, Additional Advocate General
and Mr. Gautam Sood, Deputy Advocate General, for respondent Nos. 1 and 2-State.
Cwp No. 3429 of 2023 & Cmp No. 6797 of Issue notice.
Mr. Gautam Sood, learned Deputy Advocate General, accept notice on behalf of respondents No. 1 and 2.
Dasti notice be issued for the service of respondents No.3 to 5, returnable for 20.06.2023.
Steps for dasti service be taken during the course of the day itself.
Dasti notice be handed over to learned counsel for the petitioner by 03.06.2023.

2. Prima facie, since the petitioner had disputed the apportionment of compensation made by respondent No.2, by filing a representation (Annexure P-4), seeking Reference under Section 76 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, respondent No.2 is directed not to disburse such compensation to respondents No.4 and 5, until further orders.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Counsel for the State shall report why Reference under Section 76 has not been made to the Competent Authority/Court by respondents No.1 and 2 till date.

(M.S. Ramachandra Rao) Chief Justice (Ajay Mohan Goel) Judge June 02, 2023 (Vinod)
